messages:
alex: Heads up — after yesterday's kernel-selection change we see a 12% p95 token latency regression on qwen2.5 workloads with long prefixes. Not steady, looks like KV cache warmup + batch fanout interaction.

jia: Oh no. Which change exactly? link to PR?

alex: PR is rwd/infra#4827. Kernel switch now prefers 'autokernel-v2' for mixed-head configs, we expected better throughput but profiling shows repeated KV invalidations.

sam: Can you paste the perf sample? I glanced at flamegraphs and saw a lot of memcpys inside kv_index_update.

alex: Paste below — trimmed: ```
Profile samples:
- kv_index_update: 34%
- attention_qk_kernel: 18%
- batching_router: 12%
- allocator_sync: 9%
- tokenizer.detokenize: 2%
```

toni: @alex is this primarily on multilingual tokenization runs? We had a similar warmup in the past due to token splits causing many small batches.

alex: Good call. Repro is strongest on long Chinese/English mixed prompts (seq len ~2048 with many short tokens). Batching heuristics push many small micro-batches, autokernel chooses per-batch kernel, we thrash KV indexes.

jia: Could be the kernel-selection heuristics not accounting for kv head dim mismatch on qwen2.5 (we have extra kvheads for compatibility). When kernel toggles mid-sequence, KV layout changes and we reindex.

sam: Jotting quick repro steps I ran: 
1) use model qwen2.5-32b-rope-alt
2) feed mixed-lang 2k prefix split every 16 tokens
3) run 8 concurrent streams with continuous generation
4) observe p50 ~85ms, p95 jump to ~210ms after ~30s

alex: Also saw logs like: ```WARN kernel_switcher: kernel variant mismatch — reinit kv_index (old: kvh=64, new: kvh=80)```

toni: That log nails it. Kernel variant changed KV head dim, causing full KV rebuild. Not a pure batching problem.

jia: Short-term mitigation: pin autokernel to 'stable-v1' for qwen2.5 or disable mid-sequence kernel swaps. Longer-term: make kernel selection consider persistent kv layout and avoid switching if kv dims differ.

sam: Agree. Also batching: introduce a microbatch coalescer that merges small batches within a 5ms window for same kv_layout to reduce fanout.

alex: I'll roll a canary that pins autokernel on the affected fleet and add a metric: kv_rebuild_count per model_version. Can we also add a tag in traces when kernel_switch happens?

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started rwd/canary/kv-pin — 40 hosts (tag qwen2p5-canary). Monitor dashboards: infra/perf/qwen2p5/latency.

toni: While canary runs, I'll prepare a minimal test in CI that asserts no kernel_switch with identical kv dims even when heuristics would prefer a different kernel.

jia: One more note — ropescale variants can change relative positional cache layout; ensure kernel selection compares canonical kv shape (heads * kv_dim) not just model name.

alex: Good. Action items: (1) pin autokernel on canary (done), (2) add kv_rebuild_count metric (alex), (3) batching coalescer prototype (sam), (4) CI guard for kernel switching with kv shape (toni).

sam: I'll spike coalescer and post perf numbers in this thread. If canary looks good we can roll back the autokernel change or update heuristic. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks all — I'll monitor and follow up with traces and p95 numbers in ~30m.
